properties.scienceReason: Provides the starting point for exploring Jezero Crater.
properties.why: Provides the starting point for exploring Jezero Crater.
properties.survivalNote: Use the landing area as the mission's reference location.

properties.name: Perseverance Delta Exploration Waypoint
properties.description: Recorded Perseverance location during its delta exploration.
properties.scienceReason: Represents rover exploration of the Jezero delta.
properties.why: Represents rover exploration of the Jezero delta.

properties.name: Belva Crater
properties.description: Impact crater observed by the Perseverance rover.
properties.scienceReason: Exposes geological layers that help scientists study the history of Jezero.
properties.why: Exposes geological layers that help scientists study the history of Jezero.
properties.survivalNote: Crater slopes and uneven terrain may make walking difficult.

properties.name: Hartwell Crater
properties.description: Impact crater located in the Jezero region.
properties.scienceReason: Provides an additional geological feature for crater exploration.
properties.why: Provides an additional geological feature for crater exploration.
properties.survivalNote: Inspect crater slopes before selecting a walking route.

properties.name: Neretva Vallis
properties.description: Ancient valley channel associated with water flow into Jezero Crater.
properties.scienceReason: May preserve evidence of ancient flowing water and sediment deposition.
properties.why: May preserve evidence of ancient flowing water and sediment deposition.
properties.survivalNote: Uneven channel terrain may complicate walking.

properties.name: Una Vallis
properties.description: Named valley feature in the Jezero region.
properties.scienceReason: Adds a geological landmark for studying Martian surface features.
properties.why: Adds a geological landmark for studying Martian surface features.
properties.survivalNote: Check local slope and terrain before crossing.

properties.name: Sava Vallis

properties.scienceReason: Provides a reference to a regional valley system.
